findings.description: Jantje Willems was baptized on 10 November 1748 in the city of Groningen, Netherlands, the daughter of Willem Jans and Ikjen Jans.
supporting_sources: Netherlands, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1910 — baptism entry for Jantjen Willemsen, 10 Nov 1748

findings.description: Jantje Willems's parents were Willem Jans and Ikjen Jans.
